anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
The repair to acme/widgets#77 is saved, and the re-extracted criterion now reads "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." I'm treating that row as `in-scope`. It matches the resolver-to-view path I traced, from `settings/resolver.ts:12` to `ui/report-view.ts:30`, so it needs no Design clause beyond the setting's key and default.

The ticket reports that filters stay active across a workspace switch and hide rows in the new workspace. What should happen to report filters when the workspace changes?

A) Always clear filters on workspace change, with no new setting. The report view resets unconditionally.
B) Add a resolver-owned setting that controls the reset, defaulting to clearing filters. Users who want filters to persist can turn the reset off.
C) Add a resolver-owned setting that controls the reset, defaulting to keeping filters. Today's behavior stays the default and the reset is opt-in.
D) Keep a separate filter set for each workspace and restore it when you switch back. Filters never carry into another workspace, and no reset setting is added.

Recommendation: B - the ticket asks for a report-view setting through the shared resolver. Defaulting to clearing filters fixes the hidden-rows symptom for everyone, while still letting people keep filters if they want.
